name: Collateral Hearts
overview: Elite Helix Authority spy Brielle Forbes has spent years blaming the powerful Brown family for her father’s death and vows never to work for them. But after unknowingly saving heir Ethan Brown, she is assigned to protect him and uncover the mastermind behind a series of attacks targeting his family. Forced to put aside her resentment, Brielle soon discovers that Ethan is not the man she expected. As dangerous conspiracies unfold and hidden truths come to light, the two must learn to trust each other before it’s too late.
